notes.title: Small update 18.07.24
notes.content:
After the last major update, certain players may have experienced freezes while racing. 

We have fixed this bug and it should no longer be an inconvenience for you. 

Thank you for your messages and bug reports! They help us make the game even better!

notes.title: Welcome the BlazeRush Anniversary update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6965937/b315caebb1d0bcbbe90cfeedfaf5ca27bb359178.png[/img]
Hello, racers! 

We are happy to announce that the long-awaited football-themed update [b]BlazeBowl[/b] and the big [b]StarTrack DLC[/b] for the Steam version of BlazeRush are coming out today!

After today’s update, the owners of the base version of the game on Steam will have access to a new game mode called [b]BlazeBowl[/b]. It allows you to play American football with the BlazeRush cars. Two new characters were also added to the game. Pass the ball to each other, make deceptive moves, shoot and explode; do anything to score a goal against your opponent!

The Steam players will also be able to purchase the previously unavailable [b]BlazeRush: Star Track DLC[/b]. It includes an additional campaign with 30 missions, new type of transport, a new weapon and a special boss — a huge alien spaceship!

Finally, we would like to note that we were able to add the support for [b]the Quest 2 and Quest 3 VR headsets for the Steam version of the game[/b] in this update. 

Celebrate the coming 10th anniversary of BlazeRush with us!

notes.title: BlazeRush patch 1.0.1.
notes.content:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/799ad50ba34b7cd331a255f0a4f8.png [/img]

Hello friends!

We were working hard for several weeks to deliver two features, that should help random people find each other and play together. First of all, game now uses UPnP to poke ports needed for steam matchmaking. It won't make all parties visible in the list, but we really hope that it will work for most people. Also, we will release dedicated server application, as a more practical way to host online games.

Changelog:
- Improved matchmaking.
- Fixed display on not-native aspects in fullscreen.
- Added key tips on lobby and race results screens.
- Fixed death-roller twitching on client.
- Fixed bug with additional cups in career mode.
- Fixed connection throug steam interface during gameplay.
- Fixed ping indicator in server list.
